subject: Delegated No-PO Approval Request — SpriteCloud pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan@spritecloud.io>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to kick off the 30-day pilot. Before we start, procurement on our side asked whether Redwood requires a purchase order for short pilots. Our legal/billing team prefers to invoice monthly and we typically do not issue POs for pilots under $20k.

Can Redwood accept invoice-only onboarding for a pilot scoped at ~$12k over 30 days? If not, let me know what paperwork or approvals you need and we can escalate on our side. I attached our completed vendor onboarding form for your intake.

Attachments: SpriteCloud-Vendor-Form.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Head of Partnerships | SpriteCloud
jordan@spritecloud.io | +1 415-555-0198
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan@spritecloud.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Jordan — thanks for the form and the clear ask. Short answer: we can support an invoice-only path for pilots, but that requires an internal delegation and a few gating items on our side. I will route this for a delegated no-PO approval and confirm the limits.

To help speed approvals, can you confirm the following in a quick reply:
- Estimated total pilot spend (you mentioned ~$12k)
- Billing contact and invoice email (if different from billing@spritecloud.io)
- Signed SOW or written confirmation of services and invoice cadence

I copied Marissa (Revenue Ops) and David (Finance) to help with the approval and AP routing. Marissa — is this the sort of case you can approve under the delegated allowance (single pilot <$25k)? If so, please advise any required forms we should collect from SpriteCloud.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan@spritecloud.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Rachel — thanks for flagging. I've reviewed the vendor form and Jordan's note. Per our delegated approvals matrix, Revenue Ops can authorize a no-PO onboarding for pilots up to $25,000 provided we collect:

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (received)
2) Signed SOW that defines scope and invoice cadence
3) W-9 (or equivalent tax form) for the vendor entity
4) Delegated No-PO Approval Form (we'll file this internally)

Conditions we will attach to approval: single invoice limit $15k for this pilot; any additional spend or recurring subscriptions must follow standard PO routing. Approval will be time-boxed to the pilot period (30 days).

I've attached the Delegated-NoPO-Approval-Form and will route the signed copy to Finance once Jordan provides the SOW and W-9. Jordan — if you can send the signed SOW and W-9 today we can finalize by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: Delegated-NoPO-Approval-Form.pdf (internal)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Revenue Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan@spritecloud.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Marissa / Rachel — thanks for the quick review and the conditional approval. Attached: signed SOW (SpriteCloud-SOW-Nov-2026.pdf) and W-9 (W9-SpriteCloud.pdf). The SOW confirms a single invoice at completion of the pilot (Net 30) for $11,750. Billing contact is finance@spritecloud.io.

We accept the condition of single-invoice limit for this pilot. Please let us know once Finance confirms the AP routing and the invoice address to use.

Attachments: SpriteCloud-SOW-Nov-2026.pdf, W9-SpriteCloud.pdf

Thanks,
Jordan
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan@spritecloud.io>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Jordan — we've received the SOW and W-9 and completed the internal Delegated No-PO form. Finance will accept a single invoice for $11,750 for this pilot. Please send the invoice to: ap@redwood.com and include the company name (SpriteCloud), invoice date, invoice number, and the SOW reference: REDWOOD-SOW-2026-109.

Routing notes: invoices that meet the conditions will be paid on Net 30 via ACH. Any deviation (partial invoices, additional invoices, or subscription activation) will require a standard PO and Procurement review.

I attached the executed Delegated-NoPO-Approval-Form for your records. You can proceed with onboarding; Rachel / Marissa — please mark the vendor record with the no-PO temporary flag and set the expiration to 2027-01-03.

Attachment: Delegated-NoPO-Approval-Form.pdf

Regards,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations
david_kim@redwood.com
